# Task 01: SDK-style project conversion

## Objective
Convert `ContosoUniversity/ContosoUniversity.csproj` from the legacy non-SDK-style project
format (targeting .NET Framework 4.8, `packages.config`) to the SDK-style project format
(`Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web`) targeting `net10.0`.

## Scope
- `ContosoUniversity/ContosoUniversity.csproj`
- `ContosoUniversity/packages.config` (removed)
- `ContosoUniversity/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs` (removed — attributes generated by SDK)
- `ContosoUniversity/ContosoUniversity.sln` (verified compatible as-is)

## Approach
- Replaced the legacy `<Project ToolsVersion=... xmlns=...>` MSBuild format with the modern
  4-line SDK-style `<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">` format.
- Set `<TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>`.
- Enabled `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>` and `<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>`.
- Removed all `<Compile Include=...>`/`<Content Include=...>` item globs — SDK-style projects
  use implicit globbing.
- Removed `packages.config` and converted all dependencies to `<PackageReference>` items
  (see task 03).
- Removed `Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs` (assembly attributes are now generated automatically by
  the SDK from the project file / defaults).
- `ContosoUniversity.sln` required no changes: its project type GUID
  (`FAE04EC0-301F-11D3-BF4B-00C04F79EFBC`, generic C# project) is already compatible with
  SDK-style csproj and was verified to build via `dotnet build ContosoUniversity.sln`.

## Result
Build verified via `dotnet build` — 0 warnings, 0 errors.
